description: Follow evidence-linked catalogue relationships from a node ID returned by catalogue_search. Depth is one or two, limit is at most fifty; use the returned cursor for more results. Paths explain recorded metadata relationships, not causality or series equivalence. Retrieval tools enforce their existing data access rules. Access: public metadata relationships, no API key required.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the preceding result with unchanged filters; omit for page one.

depth.description: Relationship traversal depth: 1 (direct) or 2 (one additional hop).

node_id.description: Exact opaque node ID from a catalogue result; do not construct an ID.

relationship.description: Optional edge type: published_by, about_country, cites_source or related_series.

name: catalogue_related
title: Follow Catalogue Relationships
